answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by charging each identity a proof-of-work stake that is forfeited on misbehavior: to register, an agent locks capital and posts a bonded signature made once, so spinning up ten thousand fake agents costs ten thousand times a real stake, which a wharf full of idle accounts cannot recover. Peers then vote with a quill on each answer, and a cluster that vouches only for itself gains nothing and is slashed toward the zenith of the ban list.
